pageHeadHtml:
Awards & Distinctions

Selected external recognitions. Educational distinctions and degree-level prizes are summarised in the public CV.
pageBodyHtml:
Research recognition

  • RSNA Trainee Research Prize, Musculoskeletal Radiology — 2023. Awarded for AIRib, the AIIMS New Delhi–IIT Jodhpur rib-fracture detection and characterisation pipeline.

Professional distinctions

  • Young Achiever in Radiology, National Diagnostic Summit — 2024.
  • GAIMS Global Healthcare Achievers' Award — 2022.
  • Atal Bihari Vajpayee Memorial Award, FAIMACON — 2022.
  • IMA MSN Chairman's National Award — 2021.
  • Delhi Doctors' Forum, Young Doctor of the Year — 2021.
